svg.text: XIAO ESP32-C5 meter on a breadboard: display wiring
Top view, column 1 on the left, row a at the top. Buttons not fitted yet (dashed). RGB LED not shown.
lies flat over the top edge of the board
buttons (later): D0, D1, D4, D5 to the − rail
Assumed: the XIAO's pins in rows c and g (any two rows 6 apart work: use a free hole in the same column and half);
the TFT's header in row a, with pin 1 (VCC) in column 29 and pin 9 (SDO) in column 21.
The TFT runs on 3V3 only: leave the XIAO's 5V pad unconnected. Fit an antenna on the U.FL socket before scanning.
LED straight from D9 works if the module switches its backlight (a few mA); otherwise use a transistor (BOM).
